**Злічувані:** a / an + однина, **-s** у:
**Countable:** a / an + singular, **-s** in the plural — *a bag, two bags*; how many? — **How many**
**Uncountable:** no a / an and no -s, the verb is **singular** — *The water **is** cold.*; how much? — **How much**

Common uncountable nouns: *bread, cheese, milk, water, rice, money, time, work, homework, advice, information, news, furniture, luggage, weather, traffic, hair*

Portion: **a cup / glass / bottle of**, **a piece of** (*advice, cake, furniture*), **a loaf of** bread, **a kilo of** rice
Advice is uncountable, no -s and no an.
Information — незлічуване, дієслово в од: Information is uncountable, the verb is singular.
Information — незлічуване: an зайве. Мож: Information is uncountable: an is extra. Remove it or say some / any / the information.
Luggage — незлічуване, дієслово в однині: Luggage is uncountable, the verb is singular.
advice незлічуване: без a; одна порада —: advice is uncountable: no a; one piece — a piece of advice.
advice is uncountable: no a and no -s.
furniture не має множини, хоч українсько: furniture has no plural, even if in your language the word is plural.
hair (волосся) — незлічуване, дієслово в: hair (on your head) is uncountable, the verb is singular.
job — a position, a place of work: a job.
news is singular, even though it ends in -s.
tip is countable — you can count it.
work — activity, things to do: uncountable.
Англійці ділять іменники на ті, що можна: English splits nouns into ones you can count (*an apple, two apples*) and ones seen as a mass (*water, money, advice*). This decides whether you use a / an, whether there is a plural and how you ask “how much / how many”.
She gave me some good advice.
She gave me three useful tips.
Coffee as a drink in general is uncountable.
Купиш хліба і дві пляшки молока?: Can you buy some bread and two bottles of milk?
Можна дати тобі пораду?: Can I give you some advice?
Можна каву, будь ласка?: Could I have a coffee, please?
Можна сказати one, two, three: a chair,: You can say one, two, three: a chair, three chairs.
There's borscht and bread for lunch.
We need new furniture for the bedroom.
We need four chairs for the kitchen.
Ніколи не кажіть ~~advices, furnitures,: Never say ~~advices, furnitures, informations, homeworks~~ — these words have no plural.
Рідини, їжа, матеріали: water, rice, che: Liquids, food, materials: water, rice, cheese.

Скільки грошей тобі потрібно?: How much money do you need?

Скільки яєць потрібно для вареників?: How many eggs do you need for varenyky?
I have a lot of work today.
Те, що не порахуєш руками: advice, infor: Things you can't count with your hands: advice, information, help, fun, work.
У кафе мають на увазі порцію — чашку, то: In a café we mean one portion — a cup, so a coffee.
Цілий набір речей одним словом: furnitur: A whole set of things in one word: furniture, luggage, money.
Щоб порахувати масу — посудина чи шматок: To count a mass, use a container or a piece: a cup of, a piece of.
